rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No placeholders inside fences.
Every prompt block: one-sentence action lead-in.
Canonical shape — lead-in, label with destination, blank line, fence.
Installed Skills invoke by name, never path.
Chain by back-reference + deterministic path, never invented alias.
Chained-prompt isolation — don't leak downstream pipeline.
No session-resets mid-phase.
Multi-sample methods need structural enforcement.
Markdown shout (`**bold**`, `*italic*`) inside fenced prompts = dead weight in Claude Code.
Runtime-fork prompts: paired divs, shared chip.
Runtime-mechanical scaffolding asymmetry — MORE in less-fluent fork, not less.
Append-vs-integrate — name integration mode on regeneration with new context source.
Citation discipline — extend cite-or-flag scope + quote supporting sentence.
Niceness tax — name the edge or pin the line on regeneration.
Question-dump default — `in turn` too soft; two legal shapes.
Overwrite anxiety — name overwrite default on regeneration.
Preamble before action — design around it.
Self-critique register, not defense, when Claude interrogates own work.
Minimal hand-off + Claude self-augments for send-off prompts.
Grill before save — collaborative quality at artefact assembly.
Tell me what you wrote, not show me what you'll write.
Prompt-body edits require maintainer approval — registry files AND inline blocks.
Artifact destinations are explicit subpaths, never naked filenames (Agents 101-specific).
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Lecture contains no prompt blocks; also AE101 not Agents 101.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't restate session CWD inside prompt body.
`subagent` allowed in prompt blocks; explain why after prompt.
Maintainer-approval edits — ONE-AT-A-TIME, PRIORITY-ORDERED, FOUR-FIELD cards.
Name consumer at write time — `Save it as <path>` requires downstream reader.
Strong-bold prompt label is exactly `**Prompt**` — custom labels break renderer.
Normal work request before orchestration.
Live-test corrections preserve operator workflow.
Prompts live in registry; module/exercise/lecture files reference by marker.
Module names in prompt prose are fine — they ground the session.
Git-output greps asserting exact-N need multi-result fallback.
Disambiguation, anchors, and decision logic that bind Claude live INSIDE prompt fence.
Repeated Q&A → premature re-edits. Separate iteration from persistence.
Wide prompts split by logical move — paragraph breaks = cheapest scan-affordance.
Orient saved rule by where it FIRES, not surface activity producing it.
Body lead-in mirrors prompt's opening phrasing.
Declare `permission-mode:` when paste requires specific Claude Code mode.
Verify session boundary before deciding prompt's context-carrying.
Artifact-vs-STOP tail ordering — last imperative wins.
Headless-runner discipline — tail every prompt with no-AUQ guard.
Long-running prompts stream progress — never go silent.
A leading-looking line can be a forcing function; prefer the simpler prompt.
CTO-repeatable test.
